The '''Stratos Distribution''' was a large [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] corridor of dust and [[Temperature/Legends|ice]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. It featured forests of [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Comet/Legends|cometary]] fronds, was home to several deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] lifeforms, and was the evolutionary point of origin of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Lugubraa]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The region's name was introduced by the [[Tchuukthai]] species.

==Description==
[[File:Lugubraa-TUR.png|thumb|right|300px|The Lugubraa evolved in the Stratos Distribution.]]
The Stratos Distribution was an expansive corridor of dust and [[Temperature/Legends|ice]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]<ref name="TUR" /> located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It featured forests of [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Comet/Legends|cometary]] fronds as well as asteroids rich with [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] and was a unique [[Astrophysics/Legends|astrophysical]] environment. The region's name was coined by<ref name="TUR" /> the Unknown Regions'<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> [[Tchuukthai]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE Tchuukthai">{{CSWECite|III|226|Tchuukthai}}</ref>

The Stratos Distribution was home to a number of deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] lifeforms. Those included the [[Diet/Legends|predators]] known as [[lightning-jack]]s, the membranous [[stillsail]]s that measured more than one hundred thousand [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] across, and the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], omnivorous [[Lugubraa]]. The latter shared their evolutionary history with [[Worm/Legends|wormlike]] [[chewer]]s, which were still carving [[Cave/Legends|warrens]] in mineral-saturated [[Stone/Legends|rock]] in the Stratos Distribution after the Lugubraa had expanded throughout the Unknown Regions and had come to prefer life in [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]].<ref name="TUR" />

==History==
At one point, the [[Croke]] species of the Unknown Regions, facing the catastrophic consequences of utilizing Lugubraa during a [[Croke civil war|civil war]], commissioned the [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] of the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to create a [[Gene/Legends|genetically]] [[Bioengineering/Legends|altered]] variant of the Lugubraa<ref name="TUR" /> known as the [[blind berserker]]s<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> in order to also use them in their conflict.<ref name="TUR" /> By at least several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the blind berserkers were associated with the Stratos Distribution.<ref name="Forged">''[[Forged in Battle]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Stratos Distribution was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
